title: Reading Comprehension & Writing
description: The reading and writing skills practised in every module of the book: reading for gist, scanning for a precise detail, information transfer from a text to a table and back (a biography from notes), inference, reference words, guessing a word's meaning from context, the guided paragraph (topic sentence, supporting sentences, closing sentence, unity, opinion with I think that / In my opinion) and the linkers of cause, consequence, contrast, addition and order
